mapper.select: SELECT r.execution_id, r.source_message_id, m.message_seq, r.context_json, r.context_hash FROM sq_response_execution r JOIN sq_message m ON m.user_id = r.user_id AND m.message_id = r.source_message_id AND m.conversation_id = r.conversation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND r.del_flag = '0' AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.role = 'USER' AND m.completed = TRUE FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(content)), 0) FROM sq_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND message_seq <= #{through} AND completed = TRUE AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT message_id, message_seq, role, content, revision FROM sq_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND message_seq <= #{through} AND completed = TRUE AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY message_seq FOR UPDATE
SELECT artifact_id FROM sq_message_artifact WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND message_id = #{messageId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id
